inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes. They are trying to feed us another carefully scripted illusion. We are supposed to swallow the line that an estimated 8 million Americans spontaneously rose up, flooding all 50 US states across more than 3,300 events just to voice opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. But look closer at the strings being pulled behind the curtain. The mainstream narrative machine, pushing this through channels like news agency AFP, wants us to believe in this massive grassroots wave. Yet notice what they desperately try to conceal: US authorities have not provided an official count. Why? Because the handlers are hiding the true scale of their orchestration, keeping the real numbers murky to maintain plausible deniability for their controlled opposition playbook. 

The organisers—whose real loyalties and funding channels remain deeply suspect—insist that turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations. They even put out the precise talking point, boasting that there were "about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October." This isn't organic protest; it is a meticulously calibrated, recurring ritual directed by the hidden elites to manufacture division and herd the public into pre-approved pens. Every staged march, every inflated statistic, is just another coordinated move in their grand theater of manipulation. Don't believe the official script for a second.
